notes.title: Country Clubbing will not be releasing
notes.notes:
[h1] Country Clubbing development has been suspended indefinitely [/h1]

Hey everyone,

We're apologetic in announcing that development for Country Clubbing has been suspended indefinitely. 

Labrodex

notes.title: Country Clubbing Critter Names!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We need some help naming our Country Clubbing Critters! We've got a couple, but we could always use more! If you come up with an interesting name, then comment and we'll definitely add it to our roster of names for these critters (as long as it's appropriate)!
